name: What should I do immediately after a small fire?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately after a small fire?

acceptedAnswer.text: After a small fire, prioritize safety. Ensure everyone is safe and has evacuated if necessary. Once the fire department has extinguished the fire and deemed the property safe, avoid re-entering until given the all-clear. Do not touch or attempt to clean soot-covered items, as improper handling can embed soot further. Open windows for ventilation if safe, but avoid running central HVAC systems which can spread smoke. Contact your insurance provider and a professional restoration company promptly to mitigate further damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Immediately after a small fire, ensure safety, wait for the fire department's all-clear, avoid touching damaged items, and contact your insurer and a professional restorer.
